image_description: A silver minibus parked on a paved surface under trees. The vehicle features a boxy body, a row of side windows with visible interior seats, a sliding door track, and standard van wheels. There is text/decals on the side panel.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits the characteristic high-roof, short-wheelbase proportions of a minibus (likely a Toyota HiAce derivative). The height relative to the wheel size confirms passenger capacity.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large front windshield is clearly visible. A continuous row of side windows runs along the passenger compartment, showing interior seating.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle has significant vertical clearance. A sliding door mechanism and handle are visible on the near side, positioned at the front-mid section.
The vertical seam and recessed handle indicate a sliding side door, typical for this class of vehicle.
The short hood (bonnet) ahead of the windshield indicates a front-engine layout, distinct from cab-over designs.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rear of the vehicle is outside the frame; only the front three-quarters are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle is silver with black striping and decals/text on the side, fitting the 'company livery' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible front wheel shows a standard 5-spoke alloy rim design consistent with commercial vans/minibuses.
Through the side windows, multiple rows of bench seating are visible, confirming the passenger capacity configuration.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific model/classification of the vehicle matches the 'minibus' label and rule out misclassification as a standard van or truck.
To verify the structural rigidity of the vehicle body and ensure correct spatial separation from the background trees and ground plane.
To check for edge bleeding between the silver paint and the complex background foliage, and ensure window boundaries are sharp.
To analyze the legibility and structure of the text/numbers on the side of the bus, a common failure point in AI generation.

focus_areas: Side mirror attachment and reflection consistency
Text/Decal coherence on the side panel
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the side of the bus. AI often generates gibberish here. Also, verify that the sliding door track aligns logically with the body lines and doesn't melt into the panel.
